pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Lifting His Forehead Protector to Reveal His Sharingan Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake lifts his forehead protector to reveal his Sharingan in this printable coloring page, raising one gloved hand beside his spiky hair and cloth mask. His pocketed flak jacket, thigh pouch, wrapped lower legs, and sandals stand before a village fence, leafy bushes, and a distant round tower.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Reading His Favorite Book on a Village Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake reading his favorite book on a village fence, sitting on the upper rail with his feet hanging below. Both gloved hands support the open volume, while his tilted headband, cloth mask, flak jacket, nearby trees, grass, and village towers frame the relaxed pose.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Forming Chidori in His Hand at the Training Ground Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake forms Chidori in his hand at the training ground in this printable coloring page, holding a concentrated ball of jagged lightning beside his body. The sharp energy branches contrast with his padded vest, relaxed opposite hand, thigh pouch, leg wraps, sandals, and familiar mask against the plain background.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Using Kamui to Warp an Incoming Shuriken Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake using Kamui to warp an incoming shuriken, extending an open hand toward a large swirling vortex beside him. Curved motion trails guide the four-pointed throwing star into the spiral, with his masked face, pocketed vest, bent knees, and grounded sandals emphasizing the defensive stance.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake with His Perfect Susanoo Towering Above the Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake stands with his Perfect Susanoo towering above the battlefield in this printable coloring page, forming a hand sign before the enormous winged guardian. Layered feathers, segmented armor, a horned helmet, a long sword, clawed fingers, and curling chakra outlines give the protective figure its elaborate silhouette.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Creating a Water Dragon Beside a River Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake creating a water dragon beside a river, holding a hand sign beneath the huge curling creature formed from flowing water. Its open jaws and pointed teeth rise above splashes and droplets, with river rocks, ripples, bushes, grass, and Kakashi's wide stance below.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Raising an Earth Style Mud Wall with Dog Carvings Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake raises an Earth Style mud wall with dog carvings in this printable coloring page, crouching with both palms pressed against the rocky ground. Four stern dog faces decorate the tall cracked barrier behind him, while loose stones, his masked expression, flak jacket, and bent legs frame the summoning pose.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Sending a Lightning Hound Across a Village Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake sending a lightning hound across a village street, reaching forward as the jagged canine races ahead of him. A twisting energy trail connects his hand to the pointed-eared hound, with wooden walls, tiled roofs, bushes, and a Leaf-marked tower surrounding the narrow lane.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Creating a Lightning Clone Beside a Ruined Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake creates a lightning clone beside a ruined wall in this printable coloring page, holding a two-finger sign while his duplicate reaches one open hand outward. Sharp bolts surround the second figure, with matching masks, pocketed vests, thigh straps, cracked masonry, and scattered rubble linking the two ninja forms.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Releasing Purple Lightning in Every Direction Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake releasing Purple Lightning in every direction, spreading both hands wide as sharp bolts surround his full-length figure. His spiky hair, tilted forehead protector, cloth mask, pocketed flak jacket, thigh pouch, leg wraps, and open-toed sandals remain clearly outlined within the radiating energy pattern.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Summoning His Ninja Dogs with an Open Scroll Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake summons his ninja dogs with an open scroll in this printable coloring page, kneeling among the differently sized hounds with one hand on the ground. Leaf-marked collars and headwear distinguish the pack, with varied ears, coats, expressions, and a large bulldog behind Kakashi's masked face.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Tracking a Forest Trail with Pakkun Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake tracking a forest trail with Pakkun, walking behind the small dog as it lowers its nose toward the ground. Pakkun's Leaf-marked headwear, curled tail, and compact vest lead the way between trees, rocks, grass, low shrubs, fallen leaves, and broad woodland plants.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Wearing His Anbu Armor and Fox Mask Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake wears his Anbu armor and fox mask in this printable coloring page, touching the mask beside its narrow eyes and pointed ears. A fitted protective vest, long forearm guards, fingerless gloves, back-mounted sword, thigh pouch, cropped trousers, leg wraps, and sandals complete the full-length uniform against the plain background.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as a Young Ninja Carrying the White Light Chakra Sabre Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake as a young ninja carrying the White Light Chakra Sabre, holding the straight blade across a wide fighting stance. His short-sleeved shirt, diagonal strap, forearm guards, Leaf headband, mask, and thigh pouch stand above a simple training field with rocks and bushes.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as the Sixth Hokage Wearing His Ceremonial Hat and Cloak Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake appears as the Sixth Hokage in this printable coloring page, lifting the brim of his ceremonial hat above his familiar cloth face mask. Long hanging hat panels frame his spiky hair, while a flowing flame-trimmed cloak, gloves, thigh straps, leg wraps, and sandals complete the formal full-length outfit.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Reviewing Village Paperwork at the Hokage Desk Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake reviewing village paperwork at the Hokage desk, holding separate sheets above neat document stacks in his office. His ceremonial cloak drapes over the chair, with a pencil cup, broad desk legs, a large window, village rooftops, and carved Hokage faces surrounding the seated figure.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Disguised as Sukea Carrying a Camera Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake disguises himself as Sukea carrying a camera in this printable coloring page, holding the lens-front device beneath a strap around his neck. His uncovered face, cheek markings, tousled hair, scarf, long pocketed coat, cropped trousers, leg wraps, and sandals distinguish the full-length photographer outfit against the blank background.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Without His Mask Beside a Bathroom Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake without his mask beside a bathroom mirror, touching his chin as his uncovered face appears in the reflection. A sink cabinet, soap dispenser, toothbrushes, small pot, hanging towel, woven hamper, bath mat, and potted plant give the private room its everyday detail.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Giving Team 7 the Bell Test at the Three Training Posts Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake gives Team 7 the bell test at the three training posts in this printable coloring page, holding two small bells on strings before his students. Naruto, Sakura, and Sasuke face him in ready stances, with their distinct hairstyles, ninja outfits, wooden posts, bushes, and grass framing the training field.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Teaching Naruto Tree Climbing in the Land of Waves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake teaching Naruto tree climbing in the Land of Waves, standing sideways against the tall trunk as Naruto watches from below. Kakashi's raised knee and flat soles demonstrate the unusual pose, with leafy branches, exposed roots, grass, water, and distant hills around the lesson.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Teaching Sasuke the Chidori in the Mountains Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake teaches Sasuke the Chidori in the mountains in this printable coloring page, pointing toward the jagged energy gathered around his student's hand. Sasuke crouches with a focused expression beneath his Leaf headband, while Kakashi's mask, pocketed vest, rocky ground, scattered stones, and sharp mountain ridges frame the training scene.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Greeting Naruto and Sakura After Naruto's Training Journey Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake greeting Naruto and Sakura after Naruto's training journey, raising one open hand in the middle of a village street. Naruto smiles with a hand behind his head while Sakura clasps hers together, surrounded by rooftops, leafy trees, and round Leaf-marked towers.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Teaching Naruto Wind Chakra Control with a Leaf Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake teaches Naruto wind chakra control with a leaf in this printable coloring page, gesturing as Naruto studies the small leaf held near his face. Their Leaf protectors, zipped outfits, thigh straps, wrapped lower legs, and sandals stand against a simple training ground bordered by bushes and rocks.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Shielding Sakura From Sasuke at the Samurai Bridge Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake shielding Sakura from Sasuke at the Samurai Bridge, taking a wide stance with one open palm extended. Sakura stands behind him as Sasuke faces them with a sheathed sword and thick rope belt, framed by wooden decking, ornamental rail posts, trees, and distant cliffs.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Arriving with Sasuke at the Chunin Exam Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake arrives with Sasuke at the Chunin Exam arena in this printable coloring page, walking beside his younger student across the broad tiled floor. Kakashi's pocketed vest and masked face contrast with Sasuke's high-necked shirt and shorts, while curved wall panels and a rounded doorway form the arena backdrop.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Escorting Tazuna and Team 7 Through the Land of Waves Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake escorting Tazuna and Team 7 through the Land of Waves, leading the group along a narrow country path. Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura follow with backpacks beside the bespectacled, hat-wearing bridge builder, with trees, bushes, water, and distant cliffs surrounding their route.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Confronting Zabuza in the Forest Mist Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake confronts Zabuza in the forest mist in this printable coloring page, holding a kunai low as the bandage-masked swordsman faces him across the clearing. Zabuza's enormous notched blade points toward the ground, with drifting fog lines, tall trees, leafy bushes, small rocks, and grass surrounding their guarded stances.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Trapped Inside Zabuza's Water Prison Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake trapped inside Zabuza's Water Prison, floating with bent knees and both hands raised within the rounded watery sphere. Zabuza presses one palm against its surface, while rippling outlines, splashes, a shallow puddle, wrapped arms, and a back-mounted sword complete the isolated action scene.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Facing Itachi Uchiha Beside the Village River Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake faces Itachi Uchiha beside the village river in this printable coloring page, the two ninjas standing opposite each other on the grassy bank. Kakashi's mask and flak jacket contrast with Itachi's cloud-patterned cloak, while river stones, a bridge, trees, cliffs, and village towers fill the space behind them.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Chasing Deidara's Clay Bird Through the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake chasing Deidara's clay bird through the forest, running along the path beneath the huge flying creature. Deidara crouches on the broad bird's back with his ponytail streaming, while Kakashi's bent arms, lifted leg, trees, rocks, shrubs, and grass emphasize the chase.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Battling Kakuzu Among the Forest Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake battles Kakuzu among forest trees in this printable coloring page, crouching with one hand held in a sign and the other extended toward his opponent. Kakuzu's head covering, masked face, cloud-patterned cloak, and spread fingers contrast with Kakashi's vest, framed by tall trunks, leafy shrubs, grass, and stones.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Defending the Hidden Leaf Village From Pain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake defending the Hidden Leaf Village from Pain, gripping a kunai while the cloud-cloaked opponent reaches forward with one open hand. Broken walls and piles of rubble surround the two ninjas, with damaged round towers, distant rooftops, scattered stones, and the Leaf emblem behind them.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Facing Obito Inside the Kamui Dimension Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake faces Obito inside the Kamui dimension in this printable coloring page, standing opposite the scar-faced ninja among large floating and grounded stone blocks. His pocketed vest and cloth mask contrast with Obito's tall-collared robe and wide belt, while angular platforms and cube-shaped forms fill the otherwise empty space.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Leading the Allied Shinobi Forces Third Division Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake leading the Allied Shinobi Forces Third Division, walking at the front of a small group in matching protective vests. Their Leaf protectors, rectangular chest pockets, thigh pouches, leg wraps, and sandals create repeated uniform details against low shrubs, distant hills, clouds, and rocky ground.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Wielding Zabuza's Sword During the Fourth Great Ninja War Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake wields Zabuza's sword during the Fourth Great Ninja War in this printable coloring page, gripping its long wrapped handle with both gloved hands. The enormous notched blade rises diagonally above his wide stance, with its circular opening, angular edge, pocketed vest, thigh straps, and wrapped legs clearly outlined.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Fighting Alongside Might Guy Against the Tailed Beasts Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake fighting alongside Might Guy against the tailed beasts, the two ninjas bracing before an enormous spiked, three-tailed creature. Kakashi holds a kunai while Guy raises one open palm, with heavy shell plates, fangs, jagged rocks, broken ground, and distant cliffs filling the battlefield.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Coordinating Team 7 Against Kaguya Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake coordinates Team 7 against Kaguya in this printable coloring page, raising one open hand as Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura spread out beside him. The towering horned figure floats beyond their ready stances, with long flowing hair, wide patterned sleeves, clouds, rocky ridges, and scattered stones framing the confrontation.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Visiting the Memorial Stone in Konoha Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake visiting the Memorial Stone in Konoha, standing quietly with his back partly turned toward the viewer beside the monument. A large Leaf emblem and three rectangular panels decorate the stone above broad steps, with paved ground, trees, shrubs, and small grass tufts around it.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as a Child Training Beside Sakumo Hatake Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake trains beside Sakumo Hatake as a child in this printable coloring page, holding a practice sword in both hands while his father watches. Sakumo's long tied-back hair and flak jacket stand above the small masked ninja, framed by a rope-wrapped post, wooden fence, bushes, rocks, and grass.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as a Young Ninja with Minato, Obito, and Rin Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake as a young ninja with Minato, Obito, and Rin, the four posing together with bright, relaxed expressions. Minato rests his hands above the boys, while Rin leans forward, Obito raises a fist, and masked Kakashi gives a peace sign in the simple group portrait.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as a Young Ninja Receiving a Medical Kit From Rin Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Kakashi Hatake receives a medical kit from Rin in this printable coloring page, the two holding a small ribbon-tied box marked with a cross. Rin's cheek markings and belted outfit contrast with Kakashi's mask, armor straps, and forearm guard, with their Leaf headbands, thigh pouches, and sandals completing the pair.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake as a Young Ninja Sparring with Obito Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Kakashi Hatake sparring with Obito, both standing with raised fists and bent knees in a simple outdoor training area. Kakashi's face mask and protective straps contrast with Obito's large goggles and high collar, while trees, bushes, grass, and scattered ground marks frame their ready poses.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Playing Rock Paper Scissors with Might Guy Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake plays rock paper scissors with Might Guy in this printable coloring page, holding out a closed fist as his smiling rival extends an open palm. Matching pocketed flak jackets link their uniforms, while Kakashi's spiky hair and cloth mask contrast with Guy's rounded haircut and tall ribbed leg warmers.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Racing Might Guy Through Konoha Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake racing Might Guy through Konoha, both running toward the viewer with bent arms and one knee lifted. Their matching protective vests, thigh straps, and open-toed footwear stand between wooden village walls, with a Leaf-marked roof crest, trees, stone bases, and distant towers behind them.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Talking with Sakumo Beside a Campfire Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake talks with Sakumo beside a campfire in this printable coloring page, both sitting cross-legged as his long-haired father gestures with one open hand. Matching pocketed vests and open-toed sandals link their outfits, while burning logs, pointed flames, a ring of stones, grass, and scattered rocks frame the quiet conversation.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Carrying Naruto on His Back After the Battle with Pain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake carrying Naruto on his back after the battle with Pain, walking forward while the exhausted ninja rests with closed eyes. Naruto's arms hang over Kakashi's shoulders, with small scuffs, Leaf protectors, a pocketed vest, thigh straps, wrapped legs, and sandals defining the full-length figures.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Stopping Naruto and Sasuke's Clash on the Hospital Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake stops Naruto and Sasuke's clash on the hospital rooftop in this printable coloring page, standing between his students with both open palms extended. Naruto and Sasuke hold crouched fighting poses on either side, while two raised water tanks, a metal railing, and broad roof tiles establish the setting.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Posing with Team 7 for Their First Group Photograph Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake posing with Team 7 for their first group photograph, resting his hands on Naruto's and Sasuke's heads. Sakura smiles with both hands near her cheeks between the folded-arm boys, while their Leaf headbands, distinct hairstyles, detailed ninja clothes, and sandals fill the plain-background portrait.

pages.title: Chibi Kakashi Hatake Carrying Pakkun Through the Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Kakashi Hatake carries Pakkun through the village in this printable coloring page, cradling the small dog in both arms beneath his oversized spiky head. Matching Leaf protectors link the pair, while Kakashi's mask and flak jacket stand before wooden houses, bushes, paving marks, and round village towers.

pages.title: Kakashi Hatake Traveling to the Hot Springs with Might Guy and Mirai Sarutobi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kakashi Hatake traveling to the hot springs with Might Guy and Mirai Sarutobi, walking beside his companions outside a traditional bathhouse. Guy smiles from his wheelchair while Mirai wears a flak jacket, with Kakashi's travel bag, loose robe, a steam-symbol curtain, rocks, and trees nearby.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Walking in Snowy Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Kakashi walk through a snowy village in this printable coloring page, following the clear center of a lane between snow-covered wooden buildings. Their zipped ninja outfits, thigh pouches, leg wraps, and sandals stand beside deep snowbanks, with a leafy tree, utility poles, distant roofs, hills, and clouds behind them.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Running in Village Street Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Kakashi running along a village street, lifting their knees as they move between wooden buildings and long boundary walls. Naruto's broad smile contrasts with Kakashi's covered face, while Leaf headbands, thigh straps, utility poles, hanging wires, tiled rooftops, and trees complete the neighborhood scene.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Exploring in Desert Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Kakashi explore a desert village in this printable coloring page, walking past rounded buildings as Naruto raises one open hand in greeting. Kakashi carries a ring-handled kunai beside his thigh, with domed roofs, arched doors, a market stall, well, palm trees, distant dunes, and scattered footprints around the route.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Standing in Academy Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Kakashi standing in an academy classroom, Naruto smiling with closed eyes while his taller teacher folds his arms. Their Leaf protectors, zipped outfits, thigh pouches, and open-toed sandals face the viewer, with a large board, small desks, bookshelf, and wooden floorboards behind them.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Looking Around in Woodland Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake looks around a woodland trail in this printable coloring page, walking beneath tall leafy trees with one foot lifted along the narrow path. His angled Leaf protector, mask, pocketed vest, gloves, and thigh pouch stand among fallen leaves, small rocks, grass, bushes, and exposed roots beneath the forest canopy.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Exploring in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Kakashi exploring a frozen valley, wearing backpacks as Naruto points toward the mountains beyond their snowy path. Tall icy cliffs, hanging icicles, broad snowbanks, scattered rocks, and a winding frozen watercourse surround the pair beneath a line of sharp snow-covered peaks.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Sitting in Desert Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Kakashi sit in a desert canyon in this printable coloring page, resting on a broad rock with their hands near their knees and sandals hanging below. Naruto bends one leg across the seat, while tall layered cliffs, cacti, grass tufts, small stones, clouds, and the sun frame their quiet break.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Exploring in Bamboo Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Kakashi exploring a bamboo forest, following a curving path while Kakashi keeps his hands in his pockets. Naruto smiles beside his masked teacher, with segmented bamboo stalks, pointed leaves, rounded rocks, low shrubs, and scattered grass framing their detailed ninja outfits and open-toed sandals.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Posing in Hokage Monument Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Kakashi Hatake poses in the Hokage Monument area in this printable coloring page, smiling through his mask with both gloved hands resting at his hips. A row of carved Hokage faces fills the cliff behind his spiky hair, with flags, fir trees, distant rooftops, broad paving slabs, grass, and stones around him.

pages.title: Naruto Kakashi Waving in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Kakashi Hatake waving in a frozen valley, lifting one gloved hand high above his masked face and pocketed ninja vest. Snow-covered fir trees, steep icy cliffs, hanging icicles, scattered rocks, and distant mountain peaks surround the winding path, with his thigh pouch, leg wraps, and sandals clearly visible.
